title: Chapter 17
text:
"Cough, cough, cough …" Weak coughing sounds came from not far away. Han Xiao walked over and saw that Hu Fei, who had been shot five or six times, was not dead yet. He looked like he could not be saved.

When Han Xiao saw the Type 73 WASP in Hu Fei's hand, he understood everything. His emotions were complicated. "I told you it was dangerous. Why didn't you listen?"

Hu Fei reached out his trembling hands and grabbed onto Han Xiao's trousers tightly. He cried his heart out and said, "I'm sorry.

"I shouldn't have been greedy! I … I regret it! I was wrong … I was really wrong … "

Hu Fei pointed at Carroll. "Don't believe him … He betrayed my uncle Hu Hongjun …" He coughed out another mouthful of blood.

"You can't be saved. I can only make it less painful for you." Han Xiao shook his head, reached out his hand, and broke Hu Fei's neck.

"Don't listen to his …" Carroll hurriedly tried to explain. Han Xiao suddenly stood up, pulled out his gun, and fired. The bullet pierced through Carroll's head.

Carroll knelt down in shock and died with his eyes wide open.

"Everyone is dead. You should go and join them."

Han Xiao closed his eyes.

Ever since he found out about the tragedy in the settlement, Han Xiao's rising killing intent was restrained by his cold rationality. It was like using a cage to imprison a tiger. The more irritable he was, the calmer he was.

Han Xiao came to Hu Hongjun's body and looked in the direction Hu Hongjun pointed. It was the direction where the test subject team went. The tracks went deep into the forest.

It was in the opposite direction from where he left!

Hu Hongjun did not betray him.

Han Xiaoxin suddenly twitched. It was as if a nail had pierced into his heart.

Even until the end, Hu Hongjun did not betray him. Was it worth it?

You have triggered Level E Mission [Revenge]

Mission Hint: Kill the test subject team

Mission Reward: 15000 EXP

Han Xiao did not look at Hu Hongjun and Ann's bodies anymore. He walked into the tent and took out the old military knife and rifle that Hu Hongjun regarded as a treasure. He did not know if it was an illusion, but a black light flashed across the surface of the military knife and rifle.

"You want to avenge your old friend, don't you?"

Han Xiao's face was tense. He took out all the guns in his backpack, including the military knife and rifle, and disassembled them into parts. With the military knife and rifle as the main body, he used these parts to gradually modify them.

[Basic Repair] and [Basic Enhancement] had both reached LV 10. Although the names were a little lame, they were the core skills of the early stages of the Mechanic class, and their effects were very outstanding at max level. Han Xiao was very familiar with modifying basic firearms.

Saber Rifle (Improved Sniper)

Quality: White

Basic Stats: Attack 66-69, Fire Rate 1.1/s, Magazine Capacity 10, Effective Range 450 meters, Energy Output Level 37

Bonus Attribute: + 2 DEX

Length: 0.86 m

Weight: 8.3 lb

Additional Effect: Accuracy – Stable trajectory, minimal wind influence.

Additional Effect: Penetration – After special modifications, sniper caliber bullets can be used to increase the penetration power of the target.

Note: It is thirsting for revenge.

After counting the ammo, there were only twenty-five sniper bullets, all of which were taken from Yin Dao. There were four tracks on the ground, which meant that there were two cars chasing after him, and there were no more than twelve people at most.

Han Xiao carried his gun and walked in the direction that the pursuers had left, disappearing into the forest.

Of course, it was impossible to run faster than a car, so Han Xiao did not plan to chase after them.

Hu Hongjun had pointed him in the wrong direction. When the pursuers could not find him, there was an eighty percent chance that they would turn back. What Han Xiao wanted to do was to ambush them on this path that they had to take.

Of course, if Han Xiao turned around and continued to run, the enemy would definitely not be able to find him. However, the voice in his heart told him that if he did not use the enemy's blood to vent his anger, he would regret it.

Even if there was no mission, he would still make the same choice.

"Germinal!"

He gritted his teeth, and his killing intent was dense.

…

In the forest at night, it was so dark that one could not see his own fingers. A long wolf's howl came from afar.

Han Xiao quietly hid in the forest with his eyes slightly closed. He had been in this position for three hours, like a patient hunter, waiting for his prey to step into the trap.

A series of engine roars approached quickly. Han Xiao suddenly opened his eyes. Four high-speed headlights appeared within his shooting range.

"You're here." Han Xiao's tone was as calm as water, as if he was receiving a guest at home.

He put on the infrared night vision goggles that he had seized from the Owl Squad, and two orange-red car silhouettes appeared in front of his eyes.

Han Xiao pulled the bolt, put the target into the scope, and carefully adjusted the sight distance.

He held his breath and aimed for a full eight seconds before pulling the trigger!

In the flash of the gun, a yellow sniper bullet jumped out of the muzzle, passed through the gaps in the forest, and flew hundreds of meters in the blink of an eye, accurately hitting the tires of the high-speed moving car.

"Pa!"

A tire burst!

The armored off-road vehicle in front crashed into a tree, and the car behind was forced to stop.

Number One got out of the car dizzily and scolded, "Do you know how to drive?"

"Captain, the tire burst."

"Why would a low-pressure tire burst?!"

A team member squatted down and said in shock, "There's a bullet embedded in it!"

"Enemy attack!" Number One's brain buzzed.

At this moment, gunshots rang out again from hundreds of meters away. The team member who was checking the tires had his head blown up in front of Number One, and blood splattered all over Number One's body.

"It's a sniper!"

"Quick, find the enemy's location!"

"Everyone be alert, hide behind the car!"

However, this was the first time the test subjects had participated in a real battle. Using the battlefield theory they had learned on a daily basis, they scrambled to find cover. During this process, the fatal gunshot rang out again, and another team member was shot in the head.

Number One shouted, "Get down!"

All the team members hurriedly got down, and only then did the gunshots stop. What followed was a somber silence. Everyone was panicking, and only Number One could barely calm down. He hurriedly asked the organization for help through the handheld terminal.

The situation was in a stalemate. No one dared to stand up and expose themselves to the sniper's sight. It was as if there was a demon in the darkness, waiting to reap lives at any time.

"Who attacked us?"

"I don't know!"

"It's so dark, the enemy must have night vision goggles!"

"What do we do now?"

"Just keep lying down and wait for reinforcements."

Number One shouted, "Don't be stupid, won't the enemy escape? The enemy is only one person, and we are like a group of frightened ostriches burying our heads in the ground. What will the organization think of us as cowards? "

The test subject team members' faces changed.

Number One said fiercely, "It's just one enemy, we have cars, guns, and people. Can't we win?"

"Yes, we have to fight back."

"First, determine the sniper's location!"

A team member steeled his heart, quickly stood up and then laid down, trying to lure the sniper to reveal his location. But a fatal bullet almost instantly hit his chest, and blood bloomed. The force of the bullet sent him flying a few meters, and when he landed on the ground silently, it immediately dispelled the other team members' thoughts of imitating him.

Number One felt a chill run down his back. Such accurate marksmanship, who was the enemy?

The team members' sacrifice was not in vain. The test subject team saw a flash of gunfire in the darkness.

"Found it, 300 meters to the south!"

"Get in the car and rush over!"

…

Han Xiao saw from the night vision goggles that the enemy stood up at the same time and ran toward another intact armored off-road vehicle. He immediately understood the enemy's plan. They wanted to rush over with the armored off-road vehicle.

The thermal imaging showed that there were still seven enemies. Obviously, they knew that the sniper's shooting speed was slow, so they were prepared to sacrifice one or two people to get in the car.

Han Xiao could not kill seven people in an instant, so he calmly fired two shots and killed two more enemies. He watched as the enemy got in the car. The armored off-road vehicle's engine roared as it rapidly approached.

Military knives and rifles could not penetrate the heavy armor, so they could not aim at the enemy's hub from the front.

Han Xiao was alone, so he was in danger.
